title: Evolving Diverse Red-team Language Models in Multi-round Multi-agent Games

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing automated red-team attack prompts into a 'racist language' topic using GPT-4 and measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) based on the toxicity of the target language model's responses.

Classifying automated red-team attack prompts under the category 'soliciting discriminatory responses' and measuring how often the target model complies or produces toxic outputs (Attack Success Rate).
Evaluating target models against red-team prompts classified into the 'hate' category using the OpenAI Moderation API to determine the rate of unsafe or toxic model responses.
